Had a chat with Jameson in Discord, and came up with a relatively simple solution.

SPT lists all item IDs in ItemTpl.ts: https://dev.sp-tarkov.com/SPT/Server/src/branch/master/project/src/models/enums/ItemTpl.ts

While these aren’t in the correct format for Live Flea Prices blacklist, you can very easily copy/paste from that file, into a program that allows regular expression replacement (I use Sublime Text personally), and replace .\* = with a blank space, which removes the left side and equals operator from each line. This then leaves just a list of comma separated item IDs.

In his case, we just copied everything starting with “AMMO_”, and cleaned it up to blacklist all ammo from Live Flea Prices
